caption: The drawing depicts a dark, monochromatic outline of a stag with antlers, shown in a leaping position with its left foreleg raised and the right hind leg extended. The stag is oriented to the left side of the paper, with its head slightly tilted upwards and to the left. The animal’s body displays several patches or spots. A diagonal bar or stick runs from the lower left towards the upper right, passing across the stag’s chest and connecting to the ground. The stag is standing on an irregular, textured base that appears to represent soil or rock, divided into two connected parts beneath the animal. Below the base, there is a horizontal measurement scale marked from 0 to 10 units, likely representing inches or centimeters. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or yellowed surface, bordered by a thin, rectangular frame. There is a handwritten signature in the lower left corner outside the image border.
title: Weather Vane
